description.random: Seeded random actions for all roles, including speech and votes.
description.private_vote: Detective votes for a privately confirmed living Mafia but holds the result in an empty first speech slot; other speech and votes stay random.
description.reveal: Detective also publicly reveals a positive result once per day; Villagers follow the latest living claimant's current-day positive claim when legal.
description.counterclaim: The reveal arm plus one Mafia false claim per day, only after a public Detective-style claim appears; Villagers use the same rule.
description.bluff: The reveal arm plus one false Detective claim per day from Mafia; Villagers use the same claim-following rule.
